scope: Applied/tested isolated Linux code-only implementation; anonymous controls and permitted existing regressions only
limitations: 100000-row maximum per commit/query; at most64files; bounded date window
Full integrity scan precedes selective Parquet filtering; not low-latency market-scale certification
Single SQLite catalog and local filesystem; process-kill recovery, not power-loss certification
Reverse impact covers registered edges only; DEPENDENCY_UNKNOWN prevents completeness assertion
Only explicitly non-market payloads and permitted metadata admitted; authentic positive path remains externally blocked
Read-only consumer SQL is enforced with SQLite query_only; no same-process hostile-code tamper claim
